shared_elements: incised linear markings on a flat carved panel
justification: A depicts an anthropomorphic figure in the round with a headdress, facial features, arms and a large pendant disc with curvilinear chest ornaments, while B shows only a flat rectangular field filled with horizontal rows of small repeated incised signs and no figural imagery. The only correspondence is the generic presence of shallow incised linear marks on a rectangular carved surface, which is far too universal to indicate any shared iconographic scheme.
